title: Democracia y justicia
goal: Read how Brazil took a starkly different path from Argentina or Chile -- an amnesty that left victims demanding justice, and a largely disregarded international court ruling that Brazil could not ignore its international obligations.

items: Explain what Brazil's amnesty meant for victims still demanding justice.
Explain why disregarding a final court ruling is incompatible with the rule of law.
Explain what the international court warned about international obligations.
Describe Brazil's response to that international ruling.
Use hacer caso omiso de to describe deliberately disregarding something.
